_comment: The args for tooling/shape.js, baked by `bake.py <wd> shape`. Pre-filled for PIU Scores as it stood on 2026-11-22: before the run, check the groups against ScoreTracker/ (a new vertical or page folder needs a group or a line in one) and put the owner's settle-first answers in general.json's decisions (bake.py takes the decisions from there). The inventory agent lists every route, endpoint, job, Discord surface, event and design doc from the code, so a group that misses a folder shows up as unclaimed items in the coverage check rather than as silence.

codebase.name: PIU Scores
codebase.stack: Blazor Server + MudBlazor pages and an MVC API (api/* v1, api/v2/*) over MediatR handlers, one vertical per bounded context (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), EF Core on SQL Server, MassTransit in-memory, Hangfire recurring jobs, a Discord bot, nine UI locales, per-mix themes. The official PIU site (piugame) is read through OfficialMirror.
codebase.contexts: The bounded contexts are the verticals, one project each (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md names them): ScoreLedger, PlayerProgress, ChartIntelligence, Catalog, Randomizer, OfficialMirror, WeeklyChallenge, EventCompetition, Communities, CommunityTools, ChartComments, Rivals, Seasons, Identity, HomePage, Translations. Folders take the vertical's name in kebab case (ScoreTracker.ScoreLedger -> score-ledger/). Three more folders hold the rules many features share: shell/ (every page), api/ (every API caller), jobs/ (every recurring job). A page in the Web host belongs to the vertical whose feature it shows.

leads: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/CODE-MAP.md, docs/DOMAIN.md, docs/API.md, docs/SCHEDULED-JOBS.md, docs/UX-GUIDELINES.md, docs/DATABASE-SCHEMA.md (current-state docs, leads only)
docs/design/ (about 80 design docs with decision rows D1, D2...: intent, often out of date; leads only, never rules)
inventoryHints: Routes: every `@page` directive in ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker/Pages/**/*.razor and Components/**/*.razor, and every Razor Page (.cshtml with @page: FrontDoor, Error, Privacy); id = the route as written. API: every action under ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker/Controllers/ (Api/ for v1, Api/V2/ for v2, and the non-API controllers such as the chart permalink, sitemap, culture, login and logout redirects); id = 'METHOD route' as `GET api/v2/...`. Jobs: every RecurringJob.AddOrUpdate id in ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker/Program.cs and HostedServices/RecurringJobRunner.cs (docs/SCHEDULED-JOBS.md lists them; the code wins). Discord: every bot post kind (cards, notifications, role grants) and every slash command, from the Communities vertical's bot code and the Discord adapters in ScoreTracker.Data; id = the command as typed (`/piu ...`) or a stable post name. Events: every *Event record in a vertical's Contracts/ that the vertical publishes; id = the type name. Flags: every behavior-changing configuration key (appsettings.json sections, options classes, PreventRecurringJobs and the like), with whether it is a feature switch; never copy a value. UiSettings keys (a player's saved preferences) count as flags with toggle false. Design docs: every file under docs/design/, with the features it describes. Admin pages (Pages/Admin/) belong to the vertical they administer; /Dev and DevAuth are development-only.

groups.scope: the system of record for scores: recording a score by hand, CSV and file uploads (Phoenix, XX), the plays and sittings the API posts, the two-minute batch and its flush, score history, broken bests and their cleanup. Code: ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.ScoreLedger/**, Pages/UploadPhoenixScores.razor, Pages/UploadXXScores.razor, Components/ChartRecordPanel.razor, Components/ChartQuickRecordDialog.razor, Components/ChartScoreHistoryTab.razor and what they call.

the anti-corruption layer against the official PIU site: a player's piugame import (plain, check, deep scan), import recovery, the weekly leaderboard sweep and its snapshots, the supplemented leaderboards, the official leaderboards hub pages and their admin page. Name every mapping from the official site's pages to PIU Scores' own records as a decision table. Code: ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.OfficialMirror/**, Pages/PiuGameLogin.razor, Pages/OfficialLeaderboards/**, Pages/Admin/OfficialLeaderboardsAdmin.razor, Components/ImportHistoryPanel.razor, Components/ImportResultStrip.razor, Components/InterruptedImportPointer.razor.

a player's ratings, PUMBILITY and its pages, titles and title tracks, Hardmode standings, the player page and sessions, the Phoenix recap, season stats. Code: ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.PlayerProgress/**, Pages/Progress/**, Services/Pumbility*.cs, Services/Title*.cs, Services/SessionBreakdown*.cs.

tier lists (score, pass, PUMBILITY), scoring difficulty and letter difficulties, chart similarity, the PUMBILITY presence graph, the Hardmode chart census, chart verdicts, personalized breakdowns and chart skills. Code: ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.ChartIntelligence/**, Pages/TierLists/**, Components/ChartVerdictCard.razor, Components/ChartStatsTab.razor, Domain services the tier lists use (TierListProcessor, IScoreProjector).

game content: songs, charts and mixes, chart identity and versions, the chart list and chart details page, step charts, videos, the piucenter crawl and its alias admin, folders and channels, avatars, the charts export, mix changes. Name the mapping from piucenter's chart table and step data to PIU Scores' records as a decision table. Code: ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.Catalog/**, Pages/Charts.razor, Pages/ChartDetails.razor, Pages/Tools/MixChanges.razor, Pages/Admin/BulkAddCharts.razor, Pages/Admin/PiuCenterAliases.razor, Controllers/ChartPermalinkController.cs, Controllers/ChartsExportController.cs, Controllers/StepChartController.cs, Components/Chart*.razor.

the PIU game model and the public calculators: the Phoenix score formula, grades and plates, the life calculator, the Phoenix and XX conversion calculators, the PUMBILITY calculator. Code: ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.SharedKernel/**, ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.Domain/ValueTypes/**, Pages/Tools/PhoenixCalculator.razor, Pages/Tools/PhoenixToXXCalculator.razor, Pages/Tools/LifeCalculator.razor, Pages/Tools/PumbilityCalculator.razor, Services/ScoreCalculator/**, Services/PumbilityCalculator/**, Controllers/ScoreCalculatorPlaysController.cs.

the chart randomizer, its shared settings and spectating, tournament draws; the weekly charts board and the Daily Step (Limbo Day). Code: ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.Randomizer/**, ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.WeeklyChallenge/**, Pages/Tools/ChartRandomizer.razor, Pages/Tools/RandomizerSharedSettings.razor, Pages/Tools/RandomizerSpectate.razor, Pages/Competition/WeeklyCharts.razor, Controllers/Api/WeeklyChartsController.cs, Components/Challenges/**.

tournaments and their sessions, March of Murlocs, qualifiers, tournament join; the quarterly season calendar, the season roll and backfill, the season admin page. Code: ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.EventCompetition/**, ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.Seasons/**, Pages/Competition/** (but WeeklyCharts), Pages/Admin/Seasons.razor, Controllers/Api/TournamentController.cs, Controllers/MoMRedirectController.cs, Controllers/QualifierRedirectController.cs.

communities (membership, roles and permissions, invites, leaderboards, bans), a community's Discord server (channel feeds, title-to-role mapping and the role sweep), the Discord bot's slash commands and posts, the gateway watchdog; rivals (edges, blocks, invite codes) and who may see whom. Code: ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.Communities/**, ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.Rivals/**, Pages/Communities/**, Pages/Compete/**, HostedServices/BotHostedService.cs, the Discord adapters in ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.Data/.

partner tools: the tools directory, the developer console (API keys, code, insights, players, webhooks), tool invites and player sharing, webhook delivery and its retry and prune; the public API itself (v1 and v2), its keys, versions, errors and limits, and Swagger. Code: ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.CommunityTools/**, Pages/CommunityTools/**, Pages/Admin/CommunityToolsReview.razor, Controllers/Api/**, Controllers/ToolConsoleRedirectController.cs, Swagger/**, docs/API.md (a lead).

comments and personal notes on a chart, votes, links and trusted hosts, step-chart marks; their moderation page; the translation pipeline that renders community text across locales, its queue, spend ceiling and jobs, and its admin page. Code: ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.ChartComments/**, ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.Translations/**, Components/ChartComments/**, Pages/Admin/AdminComments.razor, Pages/Admin/AdminTranslations.razor.

accounts and sign-in (piugame login, external logins, the front door), tokens, account merge, delete my data and its undo, the account purge job, the new-user setup, the account and preferences page, privacy; the home dashboard and its widgets. Code: ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.Identity/**, ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.HomePage/**, Pages/Account.razor, Pages/AccountMerge.razor, Pages/Setup.razor, Pages/YourData/**, Pages/HomeDashboard.razor, Pages/FrontDoor.cshtml, Pages/Privacy.cshtml, Controllers/LoginController.cs, Controllers/LogoutController.cs, Controllers/PreferencesController.cs, Components/Account/**, Components/HomeWidgets/**, Services/HomeDashboard/**.

the frame every page shares: layout, navigation and search, themes per mix, language and culture resolution, render modes, the static shell, SEO and the sitemap, error and not-found pages, the about page, the admin home; and the rules every recurring job shares (the schedule, parking, startup recovery, cache warmers). Code: ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker/Shared/**, App.razor, Routes.razor, Program.cs, Middleware/**, Services/Theming/**, Services/Localization/**, Services/Shell*.cs, Controllers/CultureController.cs, Controllers/MixController.cs, Controllers/SitemapController.cs, Pages/About.razor, Pages/NotFound*.razor, Pages/Error.cshtml, Pages/Admin/Admin.razor, HostedServices/**, ScoreTracker/ScoreTracker.CompositionRoot/**.

questionSources: No tracker or chat is read. Questions come from what people meet: the English UI text (Resources/*.resx for en-US), the About page and in-page help, docs/API.md (toolmakers), docs/DOMAIN.md, and the 'why' sections of the design docs. Paraphrase; no names.
questionAreas: recording and importing scores, PUMBILITY and titles, tier lists, charts and the catalog, calculators, the randomizer, weekly charts and the Daily Step, tournaments and seasons, communities and Discord, rivals, the public API and partner tools, comments and translations, accounts and your data, the site frame and languages
securityFocus: sign-in and tokens, the piugame credentials a player hands over for an import (and the session that rides an import), API keys and their scopes, webhook signing and delivery, community roles and bans, rivals' blocks and who may see whom, account merge and deletion, admin pages, rate limits and cooldowns, comment links and trusted hosts, the translation spend ceiling, anything a visitor can trigger anonymously
securitySources: SECURITY.md (the disclosure policy), the CredentialHygieneTests, SessionModeNeverPersistsBodyTests and DiagnosticExposureTests ratchets (what the repo already guards), and the code. Findings never leave the private findings folder.
